Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the discussion this morning — Ben and I appreciated the overview of your ingestion pipeline and the latency SLAs you need. It sounds like a technical walkthrough/demo would be the best next step so we can validate throughput and caching behavior on your dataset.

It looks like the calendar event didn’t include the conference URL on our end; Ben and I were ready but couldn’t join. Sorry for the confusion — wanted to follow up with a short recap and propose a couple of concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Quick recap: main priorities are (1) 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 2k qps, (2) data residency constraints in us-west, (3) integration with your key-vault for HSM-backed keys.
- Next step: 45–60 minute technical demo (hands-on) where we: run one of your sample requests, show live KV caching and autoscaling, and discuss Dedicated vs Private deployment economics.
- Please confirm one of these slots (PDT): Tue Aug 3 10:00–11:00 or Wed Aug 4 13:00–14:00. If neither works, tell us two windows that fit your team and we’ll adapt.

I’ve attached a short proposal (one-pager) that maps your priorities to the demo checklist and what success looks like.

Apologies again for the calendar mismatch — we’ll triple-check the bridge this time.

Best,
Hannah

We’re keen to proceed. Wed Aug 4 13:00 PDT would work for our engineering manager (Alyssa) and me, but can you confirm the bridge type (Zoom/Meet) and whether there will be a backup phone bridge? Our security team prefers a transient conference link and a short-lived dial-in. Also, important: Alyssa is CET-based and will be joining remotely from Berlin — she asked whether the recording will be available after the session.

Quick FYI on qualification points we discussed:
- Expected payload size: ~6KB per request, primarily text and metadata.
- Peak concurrency: ~1,200 requests/second across global region with majority in us-west.
- Compliance: need SOC 2 plus audit logs for tokenization events.

If Wed 13:00 PDT is confirmed with a backup dial-in and recording, we’ll lock it.

Thanks,
Olivia
